Both of these compounds are linked to the same target, Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. This suggests that 2,4-Dinitrophenol may act through a shared mechanism, possibly by influencing the DNMT3A2/3L complex, which in turn affects the transporter. The evidence supports a pathway where 2,4-Dinitrophenol could modulate the activity of the transporter via its interaction with the DNMT3A2/3L complex, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The integration of these findings highlights a possible role for 2,4-Dinitrophenol in regulating the transporter through a complex network of targets, emphasizing the importance of the DNMT3A2/3L complex in this relationship.
